UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: All interactive elements and key text nodes MUST contain clear data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='hero-cta-button', data-testid='booking-submit-button').
Do NOT use pure #000000 or full transparency behind text in headers or modals.
Use Lucide-react or Radix icons. Ensure generous padding and smooth hover interactions.
Ensure all text is written in natural, fluent Serbian language with a warm yet highly professional tone.
Admin panel must be fully interactive with simulated live data states and local storage support.
